connector.name: Marea - Storefront Backend for Agents
connector.registryDescription: Hosted storefront backend for AI agents: products, cart, Stripe + PayPal, delivery, order tracking.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mareaalcalina.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.mareaalcalina. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer mk_dev_* (developer key) or mk_user_* (user key). Issue one at https://mareaalcalina.com/developers/keys after sign-up.
